critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Tablet and mobile timing is stable (16.87–17.28 ms average, 0% long frames), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured midpoint is effectively identical to the end state on every viewport—opacity ≈0.45 with a 72° Y rotation and −30 px translation—so the evidence does not demonstrate smooth, progressive interpolation and suggests an abrupt or heavily front-loaded transition.
critique.fix: Retune the duration/easing so midpoint captures show a visibly intermediate opacity and transform, then provide denser frame samples across the full transition. Reduce desktop main-thread/rendering cost to approach a consistent 16.7 ms frame budget while preserving the verified reduced-motion override.
